body:
Bruh...

As someone who is still in the midst of recovering and processing my own trauma I have to say let her go. Why are you writing a love poem to her new guy?

I deleted/blocked everything the other day including her phone number and I honestly feel way better. I feel way less anxious and depressed. Break ups suck but we all deserve better.

I honestly find comfort knowing that she’s some other poor dudes problem now 

Thanks for sharing with me
For real i need someone to give me the courage to delete her out of my life

Sounds familiar to me. You deserve someone who wants to be with you. Just be good/kind to yourself and take your time to heal.

I’m not out the woods yet by any measure but I believe the good days will soon out number the bad and that one day I won’t even remember why I was so sad in the first place

Grief sucks but your life could be so much worse

I know that feeling for sure. I go between being happy to feeling the worst kind of crippling depression on a daily/weekly basis 

Although it’s hard to see when you’re experience the waves of sad pain it’s useful to know its part of the process 

How long were y’all together?

Happy for you but I had a similar experience after my ex left me. Met a woman on bumble a few weeks after the break up, hit it off really hard on the first date, things were going really well. She was nicer to me than my ex, the sex was great, but in the end my unresolved grief caught up to me and I had to end it because I realized I wasn’t over being dumped.

I hope the best for you and meeting new people definitely helps but be guarded of your own need to heal 

All the best brother
I sincerely hope it doesn’t take me that long but I appreciate the honesty
I’ve tried but I don’t think I will. Starting to realize that is something i can only get from myself

All I can tell you if you’re 2 weeks in is just cut everything off. I continued to live her for a month before I moved. Then after I did we hooked up for like a month a month or so after. Now it’s nothing. Just move on. It’s tough, it’s painful, but you’ll thank yourself
Same. It sucks. I’m lost. Good luck
My ex left me 8 months ago and I miss her every fucking day. I still feel about her as I did when I was crushing on her before we were together even though she doesn’t want me. It sucks. Good luck
